components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Standard call-to-action button in Google Blue.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background-color: #1a73e8; color: #ffffff; padding: 8px 16px; font-family: 'Google Sans', 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; border: none; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background-color: #1557d0; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(60,64,67,0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1a73e8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Canary Badge
components.description: Yellow status badge indicating unannounced pre-release discovery changes.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; line-height: 1.4; } .ds-badge-canary { background-color: #fef7e0; color: #e37400; border: 1px solid #fdd663; } .ds-dot-yellow { width: 6px; height: 6px; background-color: #e37400; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Breaking Badge
components.description: Red warning badge indicating breaking API modifications.
components.html: Breaking
components.css: .ds-badge-breaking { background-color: #fce8e6; color: #d93025; border: 1px solid #f5c2c7; } .ds-badge-breaking svg { flex-shrink: 0; }

components.name: Released Badge
components.description: Green status badge indicating confirmed release in public release notes.
components.css: .ds-badge-released { background-color: #e6f4ea; color: #188038; border: 1px solid #a8dab5; } .ds-dot-green { width: 6px; height: 6px; background-color: #188038; border-radius: 50%; }

components.name: Method RPC Chip
components.description: Interactive code chip for RPC methods and resource paths.
components.css: .ds-method-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 3px 8px; background-color: #f1f3f4; border: 1px solid #dadce0; border-radius: 4px; font-family: 'Roboto Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; color: #1a73e8; } .ds-rpc-tag { font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; color: #5f6368; background-color: #e8eaed; padding: 1px 4px; border-radius: 2px; } .ds-method-name { font-family: inherit; font-size: inherit; color: inherit; }

components.name: Change Entry Card
components.html:
BigQuery Canary

Added query session pooling support in v2 jobs API

Enables multi-statement query sessions with zero-latency session initialization.
components.css: .ds-card { background-color: #ffffff; border: 1px solid #dadce0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 16px 20px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(60,64,67,0.1); transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(60,64,67,0.3), 0 4px 8px 3px rgba(60,64,67,0.15); } .ds-card-header { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-service-pill { font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #1a73e8; background: #e8f0fe; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 4px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Google Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: #202124; margin: 0 0 6px 0; } .ds-card-summary { font-size: 13px; color: #5f6368; line-height: 1.45; margin: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Google Cloud Radar bridges the visual discipline of Google Cloud Developers Console and APIs Explorer with the scannable cadence of an early-warning telemetry terminal. It delivers high-density technical intelligence without visual clutter, prioritizing rapid skimming across services, methods, breaking indicators, and significance scores.

The interface maintains a disciplined Material / Google Developer theme palette, pairing crisp neutral surfaces with purposeful semantic accents for breaking changes (Google Red), pre-release canaries (Google Yellow), official releases (Google Green), and API identity (Google Blue).
keyCharacteristics: High-Density Scannability: Compact cards, clear metadata pills, and inline method signatures enable instant comprehension.
Semantic Color Attribution: Color is strictly reserved for state, category, and impact; never decorative noise.
Developer-Grade Typography: Clean pairing of Google Sans headers, crisp Inter body text, and Roboto Mono code chips.
Dual-Theme Fidelity: Native light and dark theme parity tuned for extended reading and console workflows.

rules.name: The Signal-First Color Rule
rules.body: Color saturation denotes change status or impact level. Surfaces and containers remain neutral so semantic badges pop immediately upon scanning.

rules.name: The Mono Precision Rule
rules.body: All API method names, parameter keys, and JSON paths are strictly styled in inline mono chips (--font-mono), never raw plain text.

rules.name: The Tonal Border Priority Rule
rules.body: Cards and containers at rest rely on crisp 1px borders. Elevation shadows activate upon user hover or modal focus.

dos: Do wrap every API method, parameter, and JSON property in mono code styling.
Do highlight breaking changes with prominent Google Red badges and warning icons.
Do preserve 1-to-1 visual parity across Light and Dark color modes.
Do keep spacing tight and scannable for engineering users evaluating multiple updates.
donts: Don't use decorative non-semantic gradients or illustrative fluff.
Don't hide breaking change flags behind collapsed accordions by default.
Don't alter official Google service names or casing in titles.
Don't rely solely on color for state; always accompany badges with descriptive text (e.g. "Canary", "Released").
